title: Collect open Impress templates and render HTML reference gallery
measurement_note: Timing record was created after web-first intake, archive download, and initial implementation had already started, so early phases are not measured and later phase times are conservative manual records.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before this timing record was created. Search covered free PPT/PPTX sources, open template repositories, conversion tools, and redistribution terms.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before this timing record was created.

phases.label: Source download and license review
phases.bottleneck_notes: Network sandbox required escalation for the GitHub archive download. License review also took time because free template sites had to be separated into raw-storage-allowed and metadata-only groups.

phases.label: Collector implementation and generation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added the collector, tests, packaged 119 .otp files, copied 119 thumbnails, rendered 119 HTML reference pages, and generated the gallery/registry.

phases.label: Documentation and history
phases.bottleneck_notes: The largest documentation cost was keeping bilingual requirements, project docs, research notes, source notes, specs, web search records, provenance, plan evidence, request trace, and work summaries aligned.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran Python tests, browser tests, registry contract check, file counts, workspace governance health, and whitespace check.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.bottleneck_notes: Grounding initially failed due enum names and work evaluation initially required mode selection and omission targets; both were fixed and rechecked.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Commit and push are pending final validation and evaluation.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The heaviest measured phase is documentation/history alignment because actual generation was deterministic and fast after the source archive was available.
improvement_candidates: Create a reusable history-bundle generator for standard work records.
Add a registry validator for open template downloads so counts and required provenance fields are checked without manual JSON inspection.
If high-fidelity conversion becomes necessary, install and audit LibreOffice once in a project-local or CI-controlled path instead of repeating renderer research.
